storeCopy.seoTitle: Baidu Images Scraper | Image Search Results
storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Baidu Images for titles, source sites, original links, previews, and dimensions. Batch queries to compare visual results and export image data.
storeCopy.intro: Find Baidu image results with titles, source pages, original image links, preview URLs, and dimensions. Search several phrases in one run to build visual reference datasets.
useCases: Visual researchers can compare image sources and dimensions across search phrases.
Content teams can find source pages and image URLs for topic research.
Market analysts can track how visual results vary across Baidu queries.
howToUse: Add one search phrase to `queries` for each image search.
Set `maxResults` to cap saved image rows for the run.
Use the original and preview URLs to review source images.

faqs.question: Does the Actor download the image files?
faqs.answer: No. It saves the result metadata and image URLs reported by Baidu.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Rank of this image in Baidu results, starting at one.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Baidu result title associated with the image page.

fields.name: title_highlighted_words
fields.description: Words Baidu highlights in the image title.

fields.name: link
fields.description: Page URL where Baidu found or displays the image.

fields.name: original
fields.description: Direct URL reported for the original image file.

fields.name: thumbnail
fields.description: URL of the small image preview in search results.

fields.name: thumbnail_middle
fields.description: URL of the medium image preview when available.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Publisher name associated with the image result.

fields.name: source_domain
fields.description: Host name of the source page, without a protocol.

fields.name: original_width
fields.description: Reported width of the original image in pixels.

fields.name: original_height
fields.description: Reported height of the original image in pixels.

fields.name: file_type
fields.description: File extension or format reported for the original image.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date string Baidu associates with the image result; formatting varies by source.

fields.name: is_gif
fields.description: True when Baidu identifies the result as an animated GIF.

fields.name: input_query
fields.description: Baidu search phrase submitted to retrieve this image result.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this record was collected.
